messages:
Maria G: heads up — i'm seeing a latency regression on the structured-output flows that do function invokes. spikes mostly on 4-8 token tool responses, but decode batches wait longer than expected
Charlie K: ugh. which route / model?
Maria G: hosted /redwood-stable-13b, route=structured-run, traffic ~12rps. repro in prod and staging-2
Ashley: any kernel switches in the trace?
Maria G: yes — profiler shows kernel churn when a tool pause happens (decode pauses for tool result + stop-token handling). snippet: 
```
batch_id=0x7f3 queue_wait=42ms batch_form_time=9ms decode_busy=120ms kernel=A10G_fp16 -> kernel=sm90_quantized (switch) kv_hits=0.72 kv_size=18MB preempt_wait=36ms
```
Linus: kv_hits 0.72 seems fine. the problem is batch formation delay after the pause?
Maria G: exactly. when the model emits a stop token and a function-invoke pause happens we hold the prefix in kv cache and the queue scheduler blocks forming new batches for that slot — queue_hold window is tuned for short outputs so the pause dominates
Charlie K: do we mis-handle the token_budget_target for structured routes? perhaps budgets assume continuous decode without external pauses
Ashley: good call. token_budget_target currently 128 for the route. function invokes often produce structured blobs that serialize to 150-300 tokens (even if many are tool args). scheduler then keeps waiting to reach budget 
Maria G: profiling shows many batches stuck at 1 active request for 30-80ms waiting for tool. this prevents aggregation and causes kernel context switches (more latency overall)
Linus: is this more of a scheduler config or runtime patch? we can quick-fix with config change (lower budget or change queue policy) or longer fix by making scheduler detect tool-pause and mark batch slot preemptible
Maria G: both. quick: reduce token_budget_target for structured-run to 64 and enable queue_prefill_for_paused=true (experiment). longer: detect external wait and decouple kernel binding so other batches can reuse same worker without swapping kernels
Charlie K: can you show the sampling of queue sizes?
Maria G: paste from tracing: 
```
T=0ms: qlen=4 (sizes: 16,1,1,2)
T=30ms: qlen=3 (16,1*,1)  (* waiting for fn result)
T=60ms: qlen=5 (2,2,1*,1,16) kernel_switches=3
```
Ashley: wallet-alloc pressure? are we ballooning kv memory causing evictions and thus extra work?
Maria G: kv_size per worker jumps ~12MB->30MB when structured outputs include tool metadata. combined with kernel swap we get throughput drop
perf-bot: perf/regression alert: structured-run 03/15 -> 03/16 p99 latency +42% for decode path. linked: https://perf.redwood/alerts/PR-2198
Charlie K: okay. proposed action list:
- immediate config change: token_budget_target=64 for structured-run (Ashley to roll)
- enable queue_prefill_for_paused=true in canary to let scheduler steal short requests around paused ones (Maria to instrument)
- runtime: add "external-wait" flag so scheduler treats paused request as preemptible (Linus backlog)
- investigate KV eviction thresholds/serialization churn (Charlie)
Linus: also add a kernel affinity hint so a worker handling paused decode doesn't force kernel swap for the next batch if compatible (low-risk micro-optim)
Ashley: i'll open a canary PR for the config change and a deploy ticket. planning a ~10m canary on staging-2
Maria G: i ran a quick sim locally — changing token_budget_target ->64 drops average batch wait from 38ms->12ms in the synthetic harness
Charlie K: nice. can you paste the harness command?
Maria G: `./sim_batcher --route structured-run --rps 12 --fn-pause 50ms --emit-stops true --token-budget 128` then `--token-budget 64` for the compare
Linus: for the longer term we should also change the default for routes that opt into function-call structured outputs: dynamic token budgets based on observed tool-latency histogram
Maria G: +1. i will add a small telemetry field for function-latency-per-request so Optimize can suggest budgets automatically
perf-bot: note: add evals for structured outputs to detect regressions when batcher changes deploy
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: canary/staging-2 by Ashley at 2026-03-16T18:20Z (ticket #INFR-4212) :white_check_mark:
Ashley: canary started. watching traces now — initial p50 improved, p99 still noisy but trending down after token-budget change :eyes:
Charlie K: keep an eye on kernel switch metric. if it drops we're good.
Maria G: thanks all — i'll follow up with a small RFC for the external-wait flag and the kernel affinity hint. moved items to eng-runtime board (INFR-4212, INFR-4213)
Linus: thx. if canary looks stable we'll roll config to prod tonight. :shipit:
Maria G: closing loop here when prod roll completes, will post final numbers
